text: D210712 asks removal or reasoning for a comment that only narrates the next line. Accepted code keeps RFC Basic-format rationale historically, XPCOM immutable ownership currently, and password-cache observer ordering currently. Proposed manual review rule: keep intent, constraints, side effects and unusual tradeoffs; remove redundant narration only when no useful contract is lost.
